question: Does the FIT-selected, HOLDOUT-validated L9H1+L9H4+L11H3+L15H5 circuit preserve its improved command effects when both are installed simultaneously?

frozen_design.population_and_arms: Reuse all 128 licensed anchors and the exact native/temporal-only/is-was-only/both independent-swap construction from the three-head joint test. Only the frozen union changes.
frozen_design.replay: Single-command H4 metrics must reproduce the immutable augmentation result within 1e-5.
frozen_design.composition_bars: For every output role x phase x template, interaction RMS/both RMS <=.10 and additive cosine >=.99. Simultaneous temporal and is-was signed recovery must remain within .05 of their single-command H4 recovery in each phase. Single-command collateral <=.01 and later-to-earlier max absolute effect <=1e-5.

predictions.pred_a_authority_h4_replay_pairing_finit: The frozen selected arm, exact replay, pairs/positions, configuration, finite closure, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_h4_single_command_quality_and_sel: Both roles reproduce their licensed FIT/HOLDOUT recovery, cosine, direction, and collateral bars.
predictions.pred_c_h4_simultaneous_execution_is_addi: Every role x phase x template interaction and additive-cosine bar passes.
predictions.pred_d_h4_simultaneous_execution_preserv: Each role/phase simultaneous recovery is no more than .05 below its single-command recovery.
predictions.pred_e_four_head_joint_program_is_licens: A/B/C/D all pass with the exact four-head set.

decision: A/B/C/D/E promotes H4 over H3 as the higher-quality distributed joint program. Any composition failure preserves the licensed H3 joint program and closes L9H4 augmentation for simultaneous use. No further head is selected here.
